paper_title: Revisiting Constraints on Resonant Axion-Photon Conversions from CMB Spectral Distortions
suggested_experiment_name: COBE/FIRAS CMB spectral distortions (resonant axion-photon conversion)
coupling_convention: f * g_agamma in GeV^-1 exactly as plotted on the y-axis of Fig. 13 (FIRAS curve assuming B0_rms = 1 nG; f is the O(1) fudge factor relating the transverse B-field to B0_rms)
notes: Paper re-derives COBE/FIRAS CMB spectral distortion constraints on resonant CMB-photon-to-axion conversion using CosmoTherm, plus PIXIE forecasts (~2 orders of magnitude improvement). The fundamental constraint is on epsilon = g_agamma*B0/(1e-10 GeV^-1 nG); text states epsilon ~= 4e-2 is 'a bit above the COBE/FIRAS limit for most of the relevant masses', and constraints are roughly mass-independent across the mu/y eras (ma ~ 1e-13 to 1e-4 eV, per Figs. 11 and 13 axis ranges). I encoded this as an approximately flat bound g_agamma ~ 4e-12 GeV^-1 assuming B0_rms = 1 nG; the limit scales linearly as 1/B0_rms and includes a fudge factor f in Fig. 13, so it is strongly assumption-dependent. Fig. 11/13 contain mass-dependent structure at low masses (multiple conversions, features near ma ~ 1e-12 eV) that could not be read precisely from the text, hence moderate extraction confidence. Additional Neff bound: epsilon < 0.26 (95% c.l.).
